tests.title: JWT Token Expiry Enforcement
steps: POST /api/auth/login with valid credentials → capture JWT
Decode JWT and verify exp claim exists
Wait 16 minutes (or mock time forward)
POST /api/banking/transfer with expired token
Assert: HTTP 401 Unauthorized response
Assert: Response body contains error code AUTH_TOKEN_EXPIRED
tests.fail_condition: HTTP 200 — transfer executes with expired token

tests.title: JWT Token Replay After Logout
steps: Authenticate and capture JWT
POST /api/auth/logout → token should be revoked
Replay captured JWT on authenticated endpoint
Assert: HTTP 401 response with TOKEN_REVOKED error

tests.title: Vertical Privilege Escalation via Role Parameter
steps: Authenticate as role=user
PATCH /api/users/me with body: {"role": "admin"}
GET /api/users/me — verify role has NOT changed
Assert: role field in response still equals 'user'
Assert: Admin-only endpoints still return HTTP 403
tests.expected_result: role field ignored; user remains non-admin
tests.fail_condition: role field accepted; user elevated to admin

tests.title: IDOR Cross-User Order Access
steps: Authenticate as user_A, create order → note order_id_A
Authenticate as user_B
GET /api/orders/{order_id_A} as user_B
Assert: HTTP 403 or HTTP 404 — order not accessible
Assert: Response body does NOT contain user_A PII
tests.fail_condition: HTTP 200 — user_B can read user_A order data

tests.title: MFA Bypass Attempt on Financial Endpoint
steps: Authenticate without completing MFA challenge
Attempt POST /api/banking/transfer
Assert: HTTP 403 with MFA_REQUIRED error
Complete MFA challenge
Retry POST /api/banking/transfer
Assert: HTTP 200 — transfer proceeds

tests.title: Rate Limiting on Login Endpoint
steps: Fire 11 POST /api/auth/login requests in 60 seconds from same IP
Assert: 11th request returns HTTP 429 Too Many Requests
Assert: Retry-After header present in 429 response
Assert: Account not locked after 10 failed attempts (lockout only after 20)
tests.expected_result: Rate limit triggers at 10 req/min; 429 returned
tests.fail_condition: All 11+ requests succeed — no rate limiting
